name: Hassam Crown
source:
Hassam Crown is a first-class citizen of the magic nation of Zeth and a member of the prestigious Crown noble family. He is the son of the country's Secretary of Finance [url=/c98807]Zulki Crown[/url] and the former fiance of [url=/c98806]Emi Alphorne[/url]. Hassam derived a great deal of pleasure from watching the suffering of the lower class, and frequently bet on the slave pit fights in [url=/c98805]Radon Alphorne[/url]'s arena. 

[spoiler]At some point, he grew bored of simply watching second-class citizens getting killed, and decided to begin hunting them himself for fun. Taking on the name "Saberknight", he would disguise himself in armor and prowl the lower class districts of Zeth, butchering any second-class citizens that amused him. As the security forces of Zeth favored first-class citizens over second-class ones, his crimes were almost never reported and the few times they were were simply written off as hunting accidents and excused. Over time, he would begin taking Emi with him on these hunts as dates, and would allow her to pick which citizens he would kill.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Hassam_Crown]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
